The merge gate (merge-gate.md, skill://legion-retro) lands retro's docs/solutions/ commit above the approved head inside this same PR, and main's history shows earlier proof runs merged such learnings and later removed them (`proof fixture: remove the handoffs and learnings`, #469, #466, #462). Recommendation: treat retro's docs/solutions/ commit like the .legion/ handoffs — Legion workflow overhead outside the `Nothing else changes` rule, which governs the implementer's change — so the reviewer checks acceptance 3 at the approved head and the merger quotes the docs/solutions-only delta in READY.
